window-1.title: net-art.org — Art projects
window-1.blurb: It's a whole archive of browser-made art by people who just wanted to build something odd and lovely, which is exactly the kind of rabbit hole you disappear into and come out of with three new side quests.

window-2.title: Naive Weekly
window-2.blurb: It's a weekly letter from the quiet corners of the internet — hand-made sites, net art, digital gardens — basically the reading version of every web toy you've ever fallen down a hole with.

window-4.title: Tour a Family of Four's Maximalist East Harlem Apartment
window-4.blurb: Four people, one apartment, zero fear of colour or clutter — this is the warm, object-stuffed, every-wall-has-a-story energy you keep chasing, and it proves a home can be maximal without ever feeling messy.
